title: ProductionValidationRecord
description: Result of a Phase 13 production-readiness check per .claude/rules/release-production.md ('a successful deploy command is not proof of healthy production'). Consumer: ops.mjs production-validation record; completion-gate.mjs requires one with status HEALTHY (or an explicit OUT_OF_SCOPE record with a reason) before a mission touching release-production.md's territory can close.
